verdicts.quote: Validation or known pre-commit failure leaves zero users from this submission and triggers no user-creation side effects.
Report the corrections found across parseable rows within the agreed limits, with offending fields when known. ... Row locations are 1-based physical start lines, with the header on line 1.
Reject the batch on ... duplicate canonical identity in the same CSV or any identity conflicting in the authoritative uniqueness domain. ... For file duplicates, flag each participating row.

verdicts.quote: Accept UTF-8 comma-delimited records with a header ... Require each mandatory header once ... Reject ... missing, unknown or repeated headers
LF or CRLF separators, optional initial UTF-8 BOM, an optional final line ending, quoted commas and line breaks, and doubled quotes inside quoted cells.
For definitive failure, the batch contributes no records or effects. An import never compensates by deleting an unrelated or pre-existing user.
Reject ... files above the published size or record limit. ... For each confirmed cap, the cap itself does not cause rejection and the first value above it does.
verdicts.missing: The actual file-size and row-count values are left to be established later.

verdicts.quote: A header and one data record suffice. An empty file or header-only file is rejected.
Repeating the same submission identity with the same input converges on one authoritative outcome and creates at most one batch.
The processing authority owns pending work and resolves each submission once, even if the initiating view disconnects.
verdicts.missing: Whether large files run asynchronously is not decided; completion is learned only by recheck, with no notification decided.
